notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
There are 3 new areas to explore all work in progress. These are Molgoth the undead world which can be accessed from the Midlands and Undertow. Apex Ether which can be discovered by crossing the Barren Bridge in Snowdonia and making your way up the summit. Frostguard which is a frozen tundra accessible from the Stormholm Citadel on the Apex Ether and the Northern Gate in Undertow. Three new dungeons to explore!
The Goblin Underground which is in the Goblin city in the Hidden Valley.
The Glacial Abyss a top the Apex Ether
The Stormholm Citadel from Frostguard and Apex Ether.

New armors and weapons along with various bug fixes and upgrades.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Player Requested Changes.
notes.notes:
New Update Log for Jan 26th 2021
Several bug fixes and player requested changes:
Fixed several bugged weapons
Black Ore can now be gathered
Static weapons on Bosses fixed
Party size has been increased to 12
Horse Cooldown has been reduced to 10
Horse prices have been reduced
Loot Timer has been extended
Issues with Bank have been resolved and now the banking system works with each individual character.
Archers can no longer shoot through walls.

notes.title: Kingdoms In Chaos Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37955511/6d508841aba3a7e02147e74a1adc8611db0c9d08.pngI apologize for not keeping the intended release date. I am a sole dev and the work flow is over whelming at this critical point when releasing your title for the first time and making sure everything is in order. My first build was respectfully declined by Steam to make the appropriate changes to properly release it to the public. The changes have been made and is now in cue for review to be released with a few days!

Thanks for your patience!
